```{r PDP}
library(DALEX)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidysdm)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Output directory
combined_outdir <- "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/stratified enviromental sampling"

# Function to create and return combined PDP plots
plot_combined_pdp <- function(var, label) {
  apicalis_pdp <- model_profile(apicalis_explainer, N = 500, variables = var)
  conditor_pdp <- model_profile(conditor_explainer, N = 500, variables = var)

  apicalis_data <- apicalis_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus apicalis")
  conditor_data <- conditor_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus conditor")

  combined <- bind_rows(apicalis_data, conditor_data)

  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = `_x_`, y = `_yhat_`, colour = Species)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Leporillus apicalis" = "#BC43FF", "Leporillus conditor" = "#00D19B")) +
    labs(
      x = label,
      y = "Predicted Suitability",
      colour = "Species"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "vertical",   # <- make legend vertical
      legend.box = "vertical",          # <- stack legend items vertically
      legend.margin = margin(t = 10),   # <- add space above legend
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(combined_outdir, paste0("pdp_", var, "_comparison.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate plots
pdp_bio05 <- plot_combined_pdp("bio05", "Maximum temperature of warmest month (°C)")
pdp_bio06 <- plot_combined_pdp("bio06", "Minimum temperature of coldest month (°C)")
pdp_bio12 <- plot_combined_pdp("bio12", "Annual precipitation (mm)")




```


```{r}


# Output directory
combined_outdir <- "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/stratified enviromental sampling"

# Create zoomed BIO12 PDP (125–700 mm)

plot_zoomed_bio12 <- function() {
  # Generate PDPs
  apicalis_pdp <- model_profile(apicalis_explainer, N = 500, variables = "bio12")
  conditor_pdp <- model_profile(conditor_explainer, N = 500, variables = "bio12")
  
  # Add species labels
  apicalis_data <- apicalis_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus apicalis")
  conditor_data <- conditor_pdp$agr_profiles %>% mutate(Species = "Leporillus conditor")
  
  # Combine data
  combined <- bind_rows(apicalis_data, conditor_data)
  
  # Create plot with x-axis limits
  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = `_x_`, y = `_yhat_`, colour = Species)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Leporillus apicalis" = "#BC43FF", "Leporillus conditor" = "#00D19B")) +
    labs(
      x = "Annual precipitation (mm; detail view)",
      y = "Predicted Suitability",
      colour = "Species"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(125, 700)) +  # Zoom to 125–700 mm
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  # Save plot with updated filename
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "pdp_bio12_zoomed_125_700mm.png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

# Call the function to create and save the zoomed plot
plot_zoomed_bio12()

pdp_bio12_zoomed <- plot_zoomed_bio12()


```
```{r}
 # Combine all four PDPs into a 2x2 grid
# Combine all four PDPs into a 2x2 grid with shared theme
combined_pdp_all <- (pdp_bio05 + pdp_bio06) / (pdp_bio12 + pdp_bio12_zoomed) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a', tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")") &
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3)
  )


# Save the new 4-panel figure
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(combined_outdir, "combined_pdp_all_4plots.png"),
  plot = combined_pdp_all,
  width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r centroid combined}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)

# Define shared colour scale
viridis_colours <- viridis(41, option = "H")

# Panel (a) — apicalis
p1 <- ggplot(apicalis_centroids, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude)) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = time_bp), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = viridis_colours,
    name = "Years BP",
    limits = c(-40000, 0),
    breaks = c(-40000, -30000, -20000, -10000, 0),
    labels = c("40k", "30k", "20k", "10k", "0")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(129, 131), ylim = c(-28, -24.8)) +
  labs(
    title = expression("(a) " * italic("L. apicalis")),
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

# Panel (b) — conditor
p2 <- ggplot(conditor_centroids, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude)) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = time_bp), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = viridis_colours,
    name = "Years BP",
    limits = c(-40000, 0),
    breaks = c(-40000, -30000, -20000, -10000, 0),
    labels = c("40k", "30k", "20k", "10k", "0")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(129, 131), ylim = c(-28, -24.8)) +
  labs(
    title = expression("(b) " * italic("L. conditor")),
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#C4C4C4", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#C4C4C4", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

# Combine plots side-by-side with shared legend and main title
combined_plot <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Add overall title
final_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Centroid shift of predicted habitat through time",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
  )

# Save output
ggsave(
  filename = "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/stratified enviromental sampling/combined_centroid_shift_plot.png",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```
